title: Imtihon strategiyasi: B2 darajasi
goal_uz: Dars oxirida B2 First va IELTS formatini tushuntirasiz, har bir qism uchun vaqt rejasini tuzasiz, kamida beshta tipik tuzoqni taniysiz va yozish hamda gapirish qanday baholanishini ayta olasiz.

scenes.title: B2 imtihon strategiyasi
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda grafik va jadvallarni tasvirlashni o‘rgandik: trendlar, taqqoslash va overview. Bugun bilimingizni ballga aylantirishni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida B2 imtihon formatini bilasiz, har bo‘lim uchun vaqt rejasini tuzasiz, tipik tuzoqlarni taniysiz va baholash mezonlarini tushunasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Today is all about strategy: the exam format, timing, common traps and how you're marked.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! Bugun strategiya haqida: imtihon formati, vaqt, tipik tuzoqlar va qanday baholanishingiz.

scenes.title: Qaysi imtihon?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: imtihon formati. B2 darajani tasdiqlaydigan eng mashhur imtihonlar ikkita. Cambridge B2 First, avvalgi nomi FCE, aynan B2 uchun yaratilgan. IELTS esa barcha darajalarni o‘lchaydi, B2 odatda 5.5 dan 6.5 gacha ball atrofida. Bugun asosan B2 First ni ko‘ramiz va IELTS bilan solishtiramiz, chunki strategiya qoidalari ikkalasida ham ishlaydi.
scenes.say: Two exams are popular at this level: Cambridge B2 First, designed for B2, and IELTS, where B2 is roughly a band of 5.5 to 6.5.
scenes.say_uz: Bu darajada ikki imtihon mashhur: B2 uchun yaratilgan Cambridge B2 First va IELTS, unda B2 taxminan 5.5 dan 6.5 gacha.

scenes.title: B2 First: to‘rt qism
board: Reading & Use of English · 1 h 15 min
scenes.say_native: B2 First to‘rt qismdan iborat. Reading and Use of English bir soat o‘n besh daqiqa. Writing bir soat yigirma daqiqa. Listening taxminan qirq daqiqa. Speaking o‘n to‘rt daqiqa, odatda boshqa nomzod bilan juftlikda, ikki imtihonchi oldida. Har qismning vaqtini oldindan biling.
scenes.say: B2 First has four papers: Reading and Use of English, Writing, Listening, and a fourteen-minute Speaking test, taken in pairs.
scenes.say_uz: B2 First to‘rt qismdan iborat: Reading and Use of English, Writing, Listening va juftlikda o‘tadigan o‘n to‘rt daqiqalik Speaking.

scenes.title: Reading and Use of English: 1–4 qismlar
scenes.say_native: Reading and Use of English yetti qismdan, jami ellik ikkita savoldan iborat. Birinchi to‘rt qism grammatika va lug‘at. Birinchisi: matndagi bo‘shliqqa to‘rt variantdan birini tanlash. Ikkinchisi: variantsiz, bitta so‘z yozish. Uchinchisi: so‘z yasash. To‘rtinchisi: gapni berilgan kalit so‘z bilan qayta yozish, bu qismda har savol ikki ballgacha.
scenes.say: Parts one to four test grammar and vocabulary: a multiple-choice cloze, an open cloze, word formation and key word transformations.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi to‘rt qism grammatika va lug‘atni tekshiradi: variantli bo‘shliq, ochiq bo‘shliq, so‘z yasash va kalit so‘z bilan qayta yozish.

scenes.title: Reading and Use of English: 5–7 qismlar
scenes.say_native: Keyingi uch qism o‘qish. Beshinchisi: uzun matn va olti ta to‘rt variantli savol. Oltinchisi: matndan olib tashlangan gaplarni joyiga qo‘yish, bu yerda bog‘lovchi so‘zlar va olmoshlar yordam beradi. Yettinchisi: o‘nta savolni matnning qismlari bilan moslashtirish. Bu qismlar uzun, shuning uchun vaqtni ularga ko‘proq qoldirish kerak.
scenes.say: Parts five to seven are reading: multiple choice, a gapped text with missing sentences, and multiple matching.
scenes.say_uz: Beshdan yettigacha qismlar o‘qish: variantli savollar, tushirib qoldirilgan gaplar va moslashtirish.

scenes.title: Writing qismi
board: Part 2: choose one — article, email/letter, report, review
scenes.say_native: Writing ikki qismdan iborat. Birinchisi majburiy esse, 140 dan 190 gacha so‘z. Sizga mavzu va ikkita fikr beriladi, uchinchisini o‘zingiz qo‘shasiz. Ikkinchi qismda uchta topshiriqdan birini tanlaysiz: maqola, xat yoki email, hisobot yoki taqriz. Bu ham 140 dan 190 gacha so‘z. Eng qulay janrni oldindan tanlab, mashq qiling.
scenes.say: Writing has two tasks of 140 to 190 words: a compulsory essay, then one choice from an article, email, report or review.
scenes.say_uz: Writing da 140–190 so‘zli ikki topshiriq: majburiy esse va maqola, xat, hisobot yoki taqrizdan biri.

scenes.title: Listening qismi
scenes.say_native: Listening to‘rt qismdan, jami o‘ttizta savol. Birinchisi: sakkizta qisqa parcha, har biriga bitta savol. Ikkinchisi: monologni tinglab, gaplarni to‘ldirish. Uchinchisi: besh kishini tinglab, variantlar bilan moslashtirish. To‘rtinchisi: intervyu va yetti savol. Muhimi, har bir yozuv ikki marta eshittiriladi, shuning uchun birinchi eshitishda vahima qilmang.
scenes.say: Listening has four parts and thirty questions, and you hear every recording twice.
scenes.say_uz: Listening to‘rt qism, o‘ttiz savol, har yozuv ikki marta eshittiriladi.

scenes.title: Speaking qismi
board: Part 2 long turn: compare 2 photos (1 min)
scenes.say_native: Speaking to‘rt qism. Birinchisi: o‘zingiz haqingizda qisqa savollar. Ikkinchisi: ikkita suratni bir daqiqa solishtirasiz, so‘ng sherigingizning suratlari haqida qisqa javob berasiz. Uchinchisi: sherigingiz bilan ikki daqiqa muhokama, keyin bir daqiqada qaror. To‘rtinchisi: shu mavzuda kengroq suhbat.
scenes.say: Speaking: a short interview, a one-minute photo comparison, a discussion task with your partner, and a final discussion.
scenes.say_uz: Speaking: qisqa intervyu, bir daqiqalik suratlar taqqoslash, sherik bilan muhokama va yakuniy suhbat.

scenes.title: IELTS bilan solishtirish
board: Writing Task 1 (150 words) + Task 2 (250 words) · 60 min
scenes.say_native: IELTS da ham to‘rt qism, lekin tuzilishi boshqacha. Listening qirqta savol, taxminan o‘ttiz daqiqa. Reading uchta matn, qirq savol, roppa-rosa oltmish daqiqa. Writing oltmish daqiqa: Task 1 kamida 150 so‘z, Task 2 kamida 250 so‘z. Speaking o‘n bir, o‘n to‘rt daqiqa, bitta imtihonchi bilan, sheriksiz.
scenes.say: IELTS also has four parts, but no separate Use of English, and you take the Speaking test alone with one examiner.
scenes.say_uz: IELTS da ham to‘rt qism, lekin alohida Use of English yo‘q, Speaking esa bitta imtihonchi bilan yolg‘iz.

scenes.title: Format haqidagi noto‘g‘ri tasavvurlar
board: ✗ 'Listening is played once.' → ✓ twice in B2 First
scenes.say_native: Uchta noto‘g‘ri tasavvur. Birinchisi: B2 First da yozuv bir marta eshittiriladi, deb vahima qilish, aslida ikki marta. Ikkinchisi: qancha ko‘p yozsam, shuncha yaxshi, degan fikr. Ortiqcha so‘z xato ehtimolini oshiradi va vaqtni yeydi. Uchinchisi: Speaking ni yolg‘iz nutq deb o‘ylash. B2 First da sherigingiz bilan muloqot ham alohida baholanadi.
scenes.say: You hear each recording twice, longer answers aren't better, and in B2 First your interaction with your partner is marked too.
scenes.say_uz: Har yozuv ikki marta eshittiriladi, uzun javob yaxshiroq emas, B2 First da sherik bilan muloqot ham baholanadi.

scenes.title: Formatni tekshiring
board: 1 How many parts in Reading and Use of English?
3 How long is the Part 2 long turn?
4 Does IELTS have a Use of English paper?
scenes.say_native: Endi formatni qanchalik eslab qolganingizni tekshiramiz. To‘rtta savol ekranda. Reading and Use of English da nechta qism bor? Writing da qaysi topshiriq majburiy? Speaking ning ikkinchi qismida necha daqiqa gapirasiz? IELTS da alohida Use of English bormi? Javoblarni inglizcha ayting.
scenes.say: Answer the four questions in English.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savolga inglizcha javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: yetti qism, jami ellik ikki savol. Ikkinchi: birinchi qismdagi esse majburiy, ikkinchi qismda esa tanlov bor. Uchinchi: taxminan bir daqiqa, shuning uchun bir daqiqalik nutqni soat bilan mashq qilish kerak. To‘rtinchi: yo‘q, IELTS da grammatika va lug‘at yozish va gapirish orqali baholanadi.
scenes.say: Seven parts. The essay. About one minute. And no: IELTS tests grammar through writing and speaking.
scenes.say_uz: Yetti qism. Esse. Taxminan bir daqiqa. Yo‘q, IELTS grammatikani yozish va gapirishda tekshiradi.

scenes.title: Reading and Use of English uchun reja
board: Skip → mark → return · never leave a blank
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: vaqtni boshqarish. Asosiy qoida: qiyin savolga yopishib qolmang, belgilab o‘ting va oxirida qayting. Noto‘g‘ri javob uchun ball ayirilmaydi, shuning uchun hech bir savolni bo‘sh qoldirmang. Bir soat o‘n besh daqiqa uchun bitta reja: birdan to‘rtgacha qismlarga yigirma besh, o‘ttiz daqiqa, o‘qish qismlariga qirq daqiqa atrofida, oxirida besh daqiqa tekshirish.
scenes.say: Don't get stuck: mark it, move on, come back. Wrong answers don't lose marks, so never leave a blank.
scenes.say_uz: Qotib qolmang: belgilang, o‘ting, qayting. Noto‘g‘ri javob ball ayirmaydi, bo‘sh qoldirmang.

scenes.title: Writing uchun reja
scenes.say_native: Writing da sakson daqiqa va ikkita topshiriq, demak har biriga qirq daqiqa. Har birining ichida: besh, o‘n daqiqa reja, yigirma besh, o‘ttiz daqiqa yozish va besh daqiqa tekshirish. Rejasiz yozish eng katta vaqt o‘g‘risi, chunki o‘rtada fikr tugaydi. Amaliy maslahat: bitta qatorda o‘rtacha nechta so‘z yozishingizni oldindan biling, imtihonda so‘zlarni birma-bir sanamaysiz.
scenes.say: Two tasks, forty minutes each: plan, write, then check. Know how many words you write per line, so you don't waste time counting.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki topshiriq, har biriga qirq daqiqa: reja, yozish, tekshirish. Bir qatorga nechta so‘z yozishingizni biling.

scenes.title: Listening: oldindan o‘qish
board: Use the reading time before each part
Predict: a number? a name? a noun?
scenes.say_native: Listening da vaqt yozuvga bog‘liq, lekin har qism oldidan savollarni o‘qish uchun vaqt beriladi. Uni bekor o‘tkazmang. Kalit so‘zlarning tagiga chizing va javob qanday bo‘lishini taxmin qiling: raqammi, ismmi, otmi? Gap to‘ldirishda bo‘shliqdan oldin va keyingi so‘zlar grammatik ishora beradi.
scenes.say: Before each part, read the questions, underline key words and predict the answer: a number, a name or a noun?
scenes.say_uz: Har qism oldidan savollarni o‘qing, kalit so‘zlarni belgilang va javobni taxmin qiling: raqam, ism yoki ot?

scenes.title: Vaqt tuzoqlari
scenes.say_native: Vaqt bilan bog‘liq tipik xatolar. Bitta qiyin savolga o‘n besh daqiqa sarflash. Rejasiz yozishni boshlab, o‘rtada qayta yozish. Qog‘oz imtihonida javoblarni varaqaga ko‘chirishni oxiriga qoldirib, ulgurmay qolish. Yechim: uyda soat bilan mashq qilish.
scenes.say: Typical time traps: getting stuck on one question, writing without a plan, and running out of time to transfer answers. Always practise with a timer.
scenes.say_uz: Tipik tuzoqlar: bitta savolga qotish, rejasiz yozish va javoblarni ko‘chirishga ulgurmaslik. Doim soat bilan mashq qiling.

scenes.title: Writing vaqt rejasini tuzing
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz reja tuzing. Writing qismida sakson daqiqa va ikkita topshiriq bor. Har topshiriq uchun reja, yozish va tekshirishga necha daqiqa ajratasiz? Raqamlarni inglizcha ayting, masalan, “I’ll spend ten minutes planning”. Jami sakson daqiqadan oshmasin.
scenes.say: Make your own plan for the Writing paper. Say it in English.
scenes.say_uz: Writing uchun o‘z rejangizni tuzing va inglizcha ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna reja
scenes.say_native: Mana bitta namuna: har topshiriqqa sakkiz daqiqa reja, yigirma yetti daqiqa yozish, besh daqiqa tekshirish, jami qirq. Ikki topshiriq birga sakson. Sizning raqamlaringiz biroz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi rejalash va tekshirishga vaqt qolishi. Oddiy xatolar aynan shu besh daqiqada topiladi.
scenes.say: For example: I'll spend eight minutes planning, twenty-seven minutes writing and five minutes checking each task.
scenes.say_uz: Masalan: har topshiriqqa sakkiz daqiqa reja, yigirma yetti daqiqa yozish va besh daqiqa tekshirish.

scenes.title: Tinglang: mock imtihondan keyin
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Dilnoza mock imtihon topshirgan va o‘qituvchisi bilan natijani muhokama qilmoqda. Unda qanday muammolar bo‘lgan va o‘qituvchi qanday maslahat beradi? Hozirgina o‘rgangan vaqt qoidalarini eslab, diqqat bilan tinglang, keyin uchta savol beraman.
scenes.say: Tutor: So, how did the mock go? Dilnoza: Badly. I spent forty minutes on parts one to four, so I didn't finish part seven. Tutor: Right. Next time, skip the hard ones and come back. What about writing? Dilnoza: My essay was fine, but the review was only a hundred and twenty words. Tutor: That's under the limit. You need a plan, so you don't run out of ideas.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qituvchi: Xo‘sh, mock qanday o‘tdi? Dilnoza: Yomon. Birdan to‘rtgacha qismlarga qirq daqiqa sarfladim, shuning uchun yettinchi qismni tugatmadim. O‘qituvchi: Tushunarli. Keyingi safar qiyinlarini o‘tkazib, keyin qayting. Yozish-chi? Dilnoza: Essem yaxshi, lekin taqriz atigi bir yuz yigirma so‘z edi. O‘qituvchi: Bu limitdan kam. Fikr tugab qolmasligi uchun reja kerak.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari
board: 1 Which part didn't Dilnoza finish? Why?
2 What does the tutor advise for hard questions?
3 What was wrong with her review?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi, Dilnoza qaysi qismni tugatmadi va nega? Ikkinchi, o‘qituvchi qiyin savollar uchun nima maslahat berdi? Uchinchi, uning taqrizida qanday muammo bor edi va o‘qituvchi qanday yechim taklif qildi? To‘liq gap bilan, ovoz chiqarib javob bering.
scenes.say: Answer the three questions on the board.
scenes.say_uz: Ekrandagi uchta savolga javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 Part 7 — she spent 40 min on parts 1–4
3 Too short (120 words) → make a plan
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: yettinchi qism, chunki u birdan to‘rtgacha qismlarga qirq daqiqa sarflagan, rejadagi o‘ttiz o‘rniga. Ikkinchi: qiyin savollarni o‘tkazib yuborib, keyin qaytish. Uchinchi: taqriz bir yuz yigirma so‘z, ya’ni 140 lik pastki chegaradan kam. O‘qituvchi reja tuzishni maslahat berdi, shunda fikr tugab qolmaydi.
scenes.say: Part seven, because she spent too long on parts one to four. Skip and come back. Her review was too short, so she needs a plan.
scenes.say_uz: Yettinchi qism, chunki birdan to‘rtgacha qismlarga ko‘p vaqt ketgan. O‘tkazib, qaytish. Taqriz qisqa, reja kerak.

scenes.title: Listening tuzoqlari
board: Distractors: the speaker mentions it, then changes
'I was going to…, but in the end…'

examples.t: I was going to take the train, but in the end I drove.
examples.uz: Poyezdda bormoqchi edim, lekin oxiri mashinada bordim.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: tipik tuzoqlar. Listening da eng ko‘p uchraydigani “distractor”, ya’ni chalg‘ituvchi. Spiker bir variantni tilga oladi, keyin fikrini o‘zgartiradi. “I was going to take the train, but in the end I drove.” Javob “train” emas, “car”. “Actually”, “but”, “in the end”, “not that one” kabi so‘zlarni eshitsangiz, ehtiyot bo‘ling: javob odatda ulardan keyin keladi.
scenes.say: Listen for changes of mind. I was going to take the train, but in the end I drove. The answer comes after but, actually, or in the end.
scenes.say_uz: Fikr o‘zgarishiga quloq soling. Javob odatda but, actually yoki in the end dan keyin keladi.

scenes.title: Reading tuzoqlari
board: Same word in text ≠ correct answer
scenes.say_native: Reading da tuzoq teskari ishlaydi. Matndagi so‘z aynan variantda takrorlansa, bu ko‘pincha noto‘g‘ri javob. To‘g‘ri javob odatda boshqa so‘zlar bilan, ya’ni parafraz qilib beriladi: matnda “cheap”, variantda “inexpensive”. IELTS dagi True, False, Not Given da esa “False” matnga zid degani, “Not Given” esa matnda bu haqda ma’lumot yo‘q degani.
scenes.say: A word copied from the text is often a trap; the right answer is usually a paraphrase. In IELTS, false contradicts the text, while not given means it isn't mentioned.
scenes.say_uz: Matndan ko‘chirilgan so‘z ko‘pincha tuzoq, to‘g‘ri javob parafraz. False matnga zid, Not Given esa tilga olinmagan.

scenes.title: Key word transformation qoidalari
board: Contractions count as 2: don't = do not
scenes.say_native: Use of English ning to‘rtinchi qismida qat’iy qoidalar bor. Bo‘shliqqa ikki-besh so‘z yozasiz, kalit so‘z ham shunga kiradi. Kalit so‘zni o‘zgartirib bo‘lmaydi: “need” berilsa, “needed” yozolmaysiz. Qisqartmalar ikki so‘z hisoblanadi: “didn’t” bu “did not”. Ma’no asl gap bilan bir xil bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say: Write two to five words, including the key word, which you mustn't change. Contractions count as two words.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki-besh so‘z yozing, kalit so‘z ham kiradi va uni o‘zgartirmang. Qisqartmalar ikki so‘z hisoblanadi.

scenes.title: Key word transformation
board: 1 I haven't seen Tom for three years. LAST → I ___ three years ago.
2 It wasn't necessary for you to bring food. NEED → You ___ food.
3 People say the director is very strict. SAID → The director ___ very strict.
scenes.say_native: Uchta transformatsiya. Har birida ikkinchi gapni birinchisi bilan bir xil ma’noda tugating, kalit so‘zni o‘zgartirmang va besh so‘zdan oshirmang. Uchinchisida majhul nisbatdagi xabar qolipini eslang. Javoblarni yozib, so‘zlarni sanang. Qisqartmalar ikki so‘z ekanini unutmang.
scenes.say: Complete each second sentence using the key word. Use two to five words.
scenes.say_uz: Har ikkinchi gapni kalit so‘z bilan tugating. Ikki-besh so‘z ishlating.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 I last saw Tom three years ago.
2 You didn't need to bring / needn't have brought food.
3 The director is said to be very strict.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “last saw Tom”, uch so‘z. Ikkinchi: “didn’t need to bring”, bu besh so‘z, chunki “didn’t” ikki so‘z hisoblanadi. Yoki “needn’t have brought”, to‘rt so‘z. Uchinchi: “is said to be”, to‘rt so‘z, majhul nisbatli xabar qolipi. Qisqartmalarni sanashni unutmang.
scenes.say: I last saw Tom three years ago. You didn't need to bring food. The director is said to be very strict.
scenes.say_uz: I last saw Tom three years ago. You didn’t need to bring food. The director is said to be very strict.

scenes.title: Word formation tuzoqlari
board: Which part of speech? noun / adjective / adverb
scenes.say_native: So‘z yasash qismida nomzodlar ko‘pincha to‘g‘ri o‘zakni topadi, lekin ball yo‘qotadi. Sababi uchta. Birinchi: so‘z turkumi, ot kerakmi, sifat yoki ravishmi? Ikkinchi: ma’no inkor talab qiladimi, ya’ni “un-”, “in-”, “dis-” kerakmi? Uchinchi: ko‘plik “-s” kerakmi? Har javobdan keyin gapni to‘liq qayta o‘qing, ana shunda xato ko‘rinadi.
scenes.say: In word formation, check three things: the part of speech, whether the meaning is negative, and whether it needs a plural.
scenes.say_uz: So‘z yasashda uch narsani tekshiring: so‘z turkumi, inkor ma’no va ko‘plik.

scenes.title: So‘z yasang
board: 2 There is a ___ of qualified teachers. (SHORT)
3 She answered ___, so she lost a point. (CORRECT)
scenes.say_native: Qavsdagi so‘zdan to‘g‘ri shaklni yasang. Har birida uch savolni bering: qaysi so‘z turkumi, inkor kerakmi, ko‘plik kerakmi? Birinchisida kontekst salbiy ma’noga ishora qiladi. Uchinchisida “so she lost a point” qismiga e’tibor bering, u ma’noni ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Form the right word from the word in capitals.
scenes.say_uz: Bosh harfdagi so‘zdan to‘g‘ri shaklni yasang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “unbelievable”, sifat va inkor qo‘shimchasi. Ikkinchi: “shortage”, ya’ni yetishmovchilik, “a” va “of” orasida ot kerak. Uchinchi: “incorrectly”, ikki o‘zgarish birdan: inkor “in-” va ravish “-ly”, chunki u fe’lni tasvirlaydi. Uchinchi savolda ko‘pchilik faqat “correctly” yozadi va ma’noni teskari qilib qo‘yadi.
scenes.say: Unbelievable. Shortage. Incorrectly, which needs both a negative prefix and an adverb ending.
scenes.say_uz: Unbelievable. Shortage. Incorrectly, unda inkor qo‘shimcha ham, ravish qo‘shimchasi ham kerak.

scenes.title: Writing tuzoqlari
board: Answer every point in the task
scenes.say_native: Writing da tuzoqlar ham bor. Birinchi: topshiriqdagi barcha nuqtalarga javob bermaslik. Esseda ikkita berilgan fikr va o‘z fikringiz bo‘lishi shart. Ikkinchi: uslub. Rasmiy xatda “Hi guys” yoki maqolada quruq rasmiy til mos emas. Uchinchi: so‘z chegarasi. To‘rtinchi: yod olingan tayyor abzaslar. Ular mavzuga mos kelmasa ball tushadi.
scenes.say: Answer every point, match the register to the reader, stay within the word limit, and avoid memorised paragraphs.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir nuqtaga javob bering, uslubni o‘quvchiga moslang, so‘z chegarasida qoling va yod olingan abzaslardan qoching.

scenes.title: O‘zbek nomzodlarining tipik xatolari
scenes.say_native: Imtihonchilar o‘zbek nomzodlarida ko‘p uchratadigan xatolar. “Informations” emas, “information”, sanalmaydi. “Make a research” emas, “do research”. “Discuss about” emas, “discuss”, chunki “discuss” dan keyin predlog kelmaydi. “In nowadays” emas, shunchaki “nowadays”. Va artikllar: “the” va “a” ni tushirib qoldirmang.
scenes.say: Watch out: information, never informations. Do research. Discuss a topic, with no about. And just nowadays, not in nowadays.
scenes.say_uz: Ehtiyot bo‘ling: information, ko‘plik emas. Do research. Discuss, about siz. Nowadays, in siz.

scenes.title: B2 First qanday baholanadi
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: baholash mezonlari. B2 First natijasi Cambridge English Scale da beriladi. 160 dan 179 gacha bu B2: 160 dan 172 gacha C baho, 173 dan 179 gacha B baho. 180 va undan yuqori A baho, sertifikat esa C1 darajada beriladi. Umumiy ball beshta ko‘nikmaning o‘rtachasi: Reading, Use of English, Writing, Listening va Speaking, ularning og‘irligi teng.
scenes.say: B2 First uses the Cambridge English Scale. A score of 160 to 179 is B2, and 180 or above earns a C1 certificate. All five skills count equally.
scenes.say_uz: B2 First Cambridge English Scale dan foydalanadi. 160 dan 179 gacha B2, 180 va undan yuqori C1 sertifikati. Beshta ko‘nikma teng hisoblanadi.

scenes.title: Writing mezonlari
scenes.say_native: Writing to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha baholanadi, har biri noldan beshgacha. Content: topshiriqdagi hamma narsaga javob berdingizmi. Communicative Achievement: uslub va janr o‘quvchiga mosmi. Organisation: abzaslar va bog‘lovchilar mantiqlimi. Language: grammatika va lug‘atning xilma-xilligi va aniqligi. Grammatika ballning faqat to‘rtdan biri.
scenes.say: Writing is marked on content, communicative achievement, organisation and language. Grammar is only one quarter of the mark.
scenes.say_uz: Writing mazmun, uslub, tuzilma va til bo‘yicha baholanadi. Grammatika ballning faqat to‘rtdan biri.

scenes.title: Speaking mezonlari
scenes.say_native: Speaking da assessor, ya’ni gapirmay o‘tiradigan imtihonchi, to‘rt mezonni baholaydi: grammatika va lug‘at, nutqni boshqarish, talaffuz va interaktiv muloqot. Savol beradigan imtihonchi esa umumiy taassurotga baho qo‘yadi. Interaktiv muloqot esa sherigingizga savol berish va uning fikriga javob qaytarish.
scenes.say: In Speaking you're marked on grammar and vocabulary, discourse management, pronunciation and interactive communication, plus a global mark.
scenes.say_uz: Speaking da grammatika va lug‘at, nutqni boshqarish, talaffuz va interaktiv muloqot, hamda umumiy taassurot baholanadi.

scenes.title: IELTS ballari
board: .25 → up to .5 · .75 → up to next band
scenes.say_native: IELTS da har ko‘nikma noldan to‘qqizgacha band bilan baholanadi. Umumiy ball to‘rttasining o‘rtachasi, yaxlitlanadi: o‘rtacha .25 bilan tugasa, keyingi yarim bandga, .75 bilan tugasa, keyingi butun bandga ko‘tariladi. Writing da Task 2 Task 1 dan ikki baravar og‘irroq, shuning uchun unga ko‘proq vaqt ajratiladi.
scenes.say: In IELTS, the overall band is the average of four skills, rounded. Six point two five becomes six point five. And Writing Task 2 counts twice as much as Task 1.
scenes.say_uz: IELTS da umumiy ball to‘rt ko‘nikmaning yaxlitlangan o‘rtachasi. 6.25 6.5 ga aylanadi. Task 2 Task 1 dan ikki baravar og‘ir.

scenes.title: Umumiy ballni hisoblang
board: A: L 6.5 · R 6.0 · W 5.5 · S 6.0 → overall?
B: L 7.0 · R 6.5 · W 6.0 · S 6.0 → overall?
scenes.say_native: Ikki nomzodning IELTS natijasini hisoblang. To‘rtta ballni qo‘shing, to‘rtga bo‘ling va yaxlitlash qoidasini qo‘llang. B nomzodda o‘rtacha .25 yoki .75 bilan tugamaydi, shuning uchun eng yaqin yarim bandga yaxlitlang. Javobni inglizcha ayting: “Candidate A gets…”.
scenes.say: Work out the overall band for candidates A and B.
scenes.say_uz: A va B nomzodlarning umumiy ballini hisoblang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. A nomzod: olti yarim, olti, besh yarim va olti, jami yigirma to‘rt, to‘rtga bo‘lsak, roppa-rosa olti. B nomzod: yigirma besh yarim, to‘rtga bo‘lsak, olti butun uch yuz yetmish besh. Bu oltidan ko‘ra olti yarimga yaqinroq, demak umumiy ball olti yarim.
scenes.say: Candidate A gets six. Candidate B averages six point three seven five, which rounds up to six point five.
scenes.say_uz: A nomzod olti oladi. B nomzodning o‘rtachasi 6.375, u 6.5 ga yaxlitlanadi.

scenes.title: Tinglang: Speaking, uchinchi qism
board: Listen: two candidates discuss ways to reduce stress before exams
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog: B2 First Speaking ning uchinchi qismidan parcha. Ikki nomzod imtihon oldidan stressni kamaytirish yo‘llarini muhokama qilmoqda. E’tibor bering: ular bir-biriga qanday savol beradi, qanday rozi bo‘ladi va qanday e’tiroz bildiradi? Bu interaktiv muloqot ballini olib keladigan iboralar.
scenes.say: Anna: Shall we start with exercise? I think it really helps. What do you think? Bek: That's a good point, but some students don't have time for sport. Anna: True. What about sleep, then? Bek: Absolutely. Getting enough sleep is probably the most important. Anna: So, shall we choose sleep? Bek: Yes, I agree, let's go for that.
scenes.say_uz: Anna: Sportdan boshlaymizmi? Menimcha, u juda yordam beradi. Siz nima deysiz? Bek: Yaxshi fikr, lekin ba’zi talabalarda sportga vaqt yo‘q. Anna: To‘g‘ri. Unda uyqu-chi? Bek: Albatta. Yetarlicha uxlash, ehtimol, eng muhimi. Anna: Demak, uyquni tanlaymizmi? Bek: Ha, roziman, shuni tanlaymiz.

scenes.title: Interaksiya iboralarini toping
board: 1 How does Anna ask for Bek's opinion?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi, Anna Bekning fikrini qanday so‘raydi? Ikkinchi, Bek muloyim e’tirozni qanday bildiradi? Uchinchi, ular qarorga kelish uchun qaysi iboralarni ishlatadi? Iboralarni aynan dialogdagidek ayting, keyin ularni o‘z nutqingizda ishlatib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Find the phrases for each question.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir savol uchun iboralarni toping.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3 So, shall we choose…? · Let's go for that.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “What do you think?” Ikkinchi: “That’s a good point, but…”, avval tan olib, keyin e’tiroz. Uchinchi: “So, shall we choose sleep?” va “Let’s go for that.” Ular bir-birini tinglaydi va fikrni davom ettiradi. Yolg‘iz nutq emas, haqiqiy suhbat. Aynan shu Interactive Communication mezonida yuqori ball beradi.
scenes.say: What do you think? That's a good point, but. So, shall we choose? Let's go for that.
scenes.say_uz: What do you think? That’s a good point, but. So, shall we choose? Let’s go for that.

scenes.title: Tabiiy nutq: vaqt yutish
board: Let me think about that for a moment.
scenes.say_native: Speaking da jim qolish ham, “anaqa”, “endi” kabi o‘zbekcha to‘ldiruvchilar ham taassurotni buzadi. Ularning o‘rniga inglizcha iboralar ishlating: “That’s an interesting question” yoki “Let me think about that for a moment”. Tabiiy nutqda so‘zlar bog‘lanadi: “What do you think?” tez nutqda “wodʒə think” kabi eshitiladi, “do you” zaif shaklda.
scenes.say: Instead of silence, buy time naturally: that's an interesting question; let me think about that for a moment. And link your words: what do you think?
scenes.say_uz: Jim qolish o‘rniga tabiiy vaqt yuting: that’s an interesting question; let me think. So‘zlarni bog‘lang: what do you think?

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: bir daqiqalik nutq
board: Photo A: students in a library
Photo B: a student learning online at home
Why might people choose to study in these ways?
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa, imtihondagidek. Ikki suratni tasavvur qiling: birida talabalar kutubxonada, ikkinchisida bitta talaba uyda onlayn o‘qiyapti. Savol: odamlar nega shu usullarni tanlashi mumkin? Taymerni bir daqiqaga qo‘ying. Suratlarni tasvirlamang, solishtiring va savolga javob bering.
scenes.say: Compare the two photos and answer the question in one minute.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki suratni solishtiring va savolga bir daqiqada javob bering.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
scenes.say_native: Namunaga e’tibor bering: suratlar tasvirlanmaydi, solishtiriladi, “whereas” bilan farq ko‘rsatiladi va savolga aniq javob beriladi. Taxmin uchun “might” va “probably”, oxirida shaxsiy fikr. Bir daqiqa ichida shu uch qadam yetarli, mock imtihonda ham shunday qiling.
scenes.say: Both photos show people studying, but in very different settings. The students in the library might want a quiet place and access to books, whereas the student at home probably prefers flexibility. Personally, I'd choose the library, because I concentrate better there.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkala suratda ham odamlar o‘qiyapti, lekin sharoit juda boshqacha. Kutubxonadagi talabalar sokin joy va kitoblarni xohlashi mumkin, uydagi talaba esa, ehtimol, erkinlikni afzal ko‘radi. Shaxsan men kutubxonani tanlardim, chunki u yerda yaxshiroq diqqat qilaman.

scenes.title: Xulosa
board: Timing: skip → mark → return · plan writing
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Format: B2 First ning to‘rt qismi va IELTS bilan farqlarni bilasiz. Vaqt: qiyin savolni o‘tkazib, qaytish, Writing da reja va tekshirish. Tuzoqlar: Listening dagi chalg‘ituvchilar, Reading dagi parafraz, transformatsiyada so‘zlar soni. Mezonlar: grammatika ballning faqat bir qismi, mazmun, tuzilma va muloqot ham muhim.
scenes.say: Know the format, manage your time, avoid the traps, and remember what the examiners are looking for.
scenes.say_uz: Formatni biling, vaqtni boshqaring, tuzoqlardan qoching va imtihonchilar nimani izlashini yodda tuting.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: a timing plan for a full mock exam
Every paper and part, in minutes
Success: totals match the real times + checking time
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: to‘liq mock imtihon uchun vaqt rejasini tuzing. Har qism va har bo‘lim uchun daqiqalarni yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: yig‘indi haqiqiy vaqtga to‘g‘ri kelsin, har qismda tekshirish vaqti bo‘lsin va qiyin savollar uchun qoidangiz yozilgan bo‘lsin. Keyingi darsda B2 yakuniy imtihonini topshirasiz va sertifikat olasiz.
scenes.say: Plan your timing for a full mock exam, part by part, with time to check. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: To‘liq mock imtihon uchun vaqtni qism-qism, tekshirish vaqti bilan rejalang. Omad!

homework_uz: To‘liq mock imtihon uchun vaqt rejasini tuzing: har bir qism va bo‘lim uchun daqiqalarni yozing. Mezon: yig‘indi haqiqiy imtihon vaqtiga to‘g‘ri kelsin, har qismda tekshirish vaqti bo‘lsin va qiyin savollar uchun aniq qoidangiz yozilgan bo‘lsin.

quiz.q: How many parts does B2 First Reading and Use of English have?
In B2 First Writing, which task is compulsory?
quiz.why_uz: Birinchi qismdagi esse majburiy, ikkinchisida tanlov bor.

quiz.q: In B2 First Listening, each recording is played…
'I was going to fly, but in the end I took the bus.' How did the speaker travel?
quiz.why_uz: Javob but va in the end dan keyin keladi: bus.

quiz.q: In a key word transformation, 'didn't' counts as…
quiz.why_uz: Qisqartmalar ikki so‘z hisoblanadi: did not.
Sifat kerak va kontekst inkor: unbelievable.

options: We made a discussion about the problem.

quiz.q: A B2 First score of 182 means…
IELTS scores: 7.0, 6.5, 6.0, 6.0. What is the overall band?

options: counts twice as much as Task 1
quiz.why_uz: Task 2 ikki baravar og‘ir va kamida 250 so‘z.
